Dalmia Bharat Global Holdings Limited was incorporated in Abu Dhabi Global Market on October 14, 2026 as a wholly owned subsidiary to hold the company's present and future foreign investments.

Step-down subsidiary Eagle Agrotech Tanzania Limited executed an $87.5 million term loan agreement with CRDB Bank for the Tanzania project, with DBSIL sponsoring an SBLC covering 51% of the principal.

timeline.summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar filed an e-appeal against a ₹42.54 Cr income tax assessment order for AY 2023-24.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹990.73 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹104.47 Cr.
Dalmia Bharat Sugar's board approved amending its Memorandum of Association to enter the biofuels, renewable fuels, and green hydrogen business.
Y.H. Dalmia and 68 related entities declared no encumbrance on Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
On 14 October 2026, Dalmia Bharat Sugar incorporated Dalmia Bharat Global Holdings Limited in Abu Dhabi Global Market as a wholly owned subsidiary to hold its present and future foreign investments.
On 22 October 2026, Dalmia Bharat Sugar announced that its step-down subsidiary Eagle Agrotech Tanzania Limited executed an $87.5 million term loan facility with CRDB Bank, backed by a parent SBLC.
